summary: Mira Mira on the Wall: Will Tanker Rates Rise or Fall? While Venezuelans await Sunday's referendum to see whether or not their president, Hugo Chavez, will continue his six-year term, the oil tanker industry and the broader economic community await the impact the vote will have on the oil market. Chavez, who was elected in 2000, is faced with losing the presidency after his political opponents obtained two million signatures to force a referendum vote.

children.title: Tanker Replacement
children.summary: The tanker market will most certainly feel the drop if 2.3 million barrels per day falls away from the market and will look to the Persian Gulf to replace it. With that, expect a rise in VLCC use and higher freight rates for these longer voyages.
